editorial:
Ever feel like you are just too bored for your own good? You will totally relate to Taylor and Murphy, two guys from Ohio who decide they have had enough of their dull lives. They pack their bags and head to Hollywood thinking they can make it big. The vibe is super light and funny, showing the wild difference between a quiet town and the crazy energy of LA. It is a classic buddy comedy where one guy gets lucky while the other gets into a total mess. You get to see Murphy somehow stumble his way into producing a weird show about Pac-Man, while Taylor ends up in a nightmare when the police think he killed someone.

The acting is great and the timing of the jokes really keeps you laughing. The best part is watching Murphy fail upward while Taylor tries to clear his name. It does slow down a bit in the middle, but the payoff is worth it. If you love stories about underdogs and weird luck, you have to see this. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you really love the retro look, you should grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the real killer is finally caught during a big TV event for the Pac-Man show. Taylor is proven innocent just in time, and the police apologize for the mix-up. Murphy realizes that being a producer is too much stress and decides he prefers being a goofball. The two friends end up staying in Hollywood, but they learn that being yourself is better than pretending to be a big shot.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy buddy comedies and fish-out-of-water stories.
